claude.rationale: The deal is structured as a pure section 363 distressed-asset acquisition of undeveloped Marcellus/Utica leasehold and fee acreage plus drilling rights and producing royalty interests (T4 subset); the filings expressly state "no operating organization, workforce, management, or producing/delivery processes" transfer with the acreage, so T5 and T6 are null. Because no operational process (T5) or organization (T6) crossed the boundary at all, there is no product-vs-process transfer mismatch (gap_45=0) and no process-vs-organization mismatch (gap_56=0) — neither operational tier moved, so nothing was left behind relative to what transferred. The acquirer's own controlling intent persists as buyer (T1 continue); no Tier-1 fusion is documented.

gemini.rationale: The slice explicitly states that the acquisition was for undeveloped mineral leasehold and fee acreage (T4), and 'the filings describe no operating organization, workforce, management, or producing/delivery processes as transferring with the acreage' (T5, T6). This creates a structural gap between the asset and the processes (gap_45 = 1), but since neither processes nor organization transferred, there is no gap between T5 and T6 (gap_56 = 0).

openai.rationale: The proposed acquisition covered specified undeveloped Marcellus and Utica leasehold and fee acreage, drilling rights, and producing royalty interests, while the filings expressly described no producing or delivery processes as transferring with those assets [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-16-543288, Form 8-K Item 8.01 / EX-99.3]. Because no operational processes transferred or were re-engineered, there was no process-versus-organization mismatch under gap_56; the filings likewise described no workforce, management, operating organization, or transitional-services arrangement transferring with the acreage [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-16-543288, Form 8-K Items 1.01/8.01, EX-99.3].
